kw.name: Open Bench
kw.msg: Set suite metadata 'Radio' to value 'Retevis C62/C2 (c62)'.
Set suite metadata 'Hardware' to value 'Retevis C62 2501R0621100415'.
Set suite metadata 'Calibration' to value 'assumed, measured 2026-10-20 (d55ce4aa0a3c)'.
Set suite metadata 'Suite commit' to value '4818e0cd0b'.
kw.doc: Load the bench, its calibration and the radio file, and prepare the instruments. All five are mandatory and differ from tester to tester, so suites take them from the command line (-v BENCH:... and so on). `firmware` names what the radio runs, such as a git describe; `hardware` names the unit, by model and serial number, since units of one model measure differently. `dsp` names the DSP image the radio's audio processor runs, such as its sha256; it is mandatory for radio files with dsp_image: true, whose firmware states can differ in it alone.

suite.doc:
FM follows the 12.5/25 kHz channel bandwidth setting, on transmit and on receive, on every band the radio has.
Run it with a bench's argument file (bench/example.args), whose oat.expand repeats each test on every band in the radio file. Transmit is measured from the SDR capture; receive is judged by the operator, until the radio can report its own audio. The programming cable stays out throughout: it disconnects the mic and the speaker.
To measure stock firmware as a reference, exclude mode:m17.
